about: the country index lists no countries, so Prepare countries returns no items and nothing is scraped or inserted

responses.body: Browse by Country

connector.none: no captured connector fetches web pages

reads.note: HTTP Request v1, responseFormat string: GET the country index; HTML Extract takes every `ol > li > a` href

uProc getCountryNormalized: POST https://api.uproc.io/api/v2/process {processor: 'get-country-normalized', params: {country}} (n8n-nodes-base 2.47.7 UProc.node.js); the template reads message.code. Response shape beyond message.code is assumed (uProc's public docs, unverified)

connector.none: no captured connector fetches web pages

reads.note: HTTP Request v1, responseFormat file: only runs for a page missing from the cache; the same pages as the cached files

branches: no country reaches SplitInBatches; no IF runs
expect.offline: Read Binary File fails on a missing file (n8n 2.47.7 ReadBinaryFile throws ENOENT; alwaysOutputData does not catch errors), so a first run on an empty cache stops there whatever the site answers. The fixture therefore places every page the run asks for in the scraper's cache (/home/node/.cache/scrapper/, `file` sources), File exists? holds and HTTP Request1, Wait and Write Binary File stay off the path; their routes are given anyway. Set Page to Scrape and Set More Pages keep the next page in workflow static data, which starts empty. MongoDB inserts cannot be answered offline (no MongoDB sidecar); createdAt and updatedAt are run-time dates
expect.n8nCannotRun: MongoDB1 has no bench sidecar yet (PROPOSALS P66; Execute Command runs since P93)

n8nFails.why: n8n 2.47.7 refuses to start the run: uProc (tool getCountryNormalized) requires the parameter Language, which the template leaves empty (canned check, R4e)
